runtime_implementation.scope: Typed gem placement owner: arc-length rows with start/end/spacing, taper, count fit, heterogeneous lists, atomic multi-curve runs, profile/girdle/guides, surface UV frames, follow/flow/splop and the persisted om9.gem.placement link
runtime_implementation.notes: Placement trả dữ liệu thuần; apply là một transaction. Link om9.gem.placement lưu source/arc/station/uv/revision và có trạng thái ACTIVE/CONFLICT. Không copy asset Matrix. 11 L3 đều còn gate M05-UI.
remaining: All eleven L3 keep the M05-UI manual gate open: no human has reviewed the placement commands on screen and no reviewer signature is claimed.
Only Windows x64 was exercised in this run.
The app test binaries link OCCT, so the run needs the OCCT bin and VC runtime directories on PATH; that environment requirement is recorded, not hidden.
CARGO_TARGET_DIR is H:/OpenMatrix9/cargo-target because this sandbox denies writes to the L:/om9-target directory named in AGENTS.md.

The clippy gate is scoped to the files this task owns: the shared checkout also contains concurrent in-flight work (for example the settings module and the head_commands tests), so its warnings are listed in clippy_foreign_warnings and left to that owner instead of failing this batch.

The crate-wide `cargo test -p om9-app --lib` reports 188 passed and 4 `ui::layer_dialog_audit` failures in this non-interactive session: those tests create fixtures under build/standalone-validation with a restricted token and fail with `os error 5` before reaching any placement code. The failures are environmental and recorded in app-lib-os-restriction.log, not hidden.
The placement preview is session data; painting it as a shaded viewport proxy remains a separate UI task.
